rooms.name: Standing on a Sandbar
rooms.desc:
This is the western tip of a small sandbar at what looks like the entrance
to a larger bay to the south. Although the sandbar is high enough to keep
you dry, the sand itself is quite moist and is difficult to move through.

rooms.name: Standing on a Sandbar
rooms.desc:
You are on a narrow strip of sand which runs east-west. Further to the
east you can see a wooden jetty which may have berthed one or two ships in
its time. To the south, the calmer waters of a large bay look slightly more
inviting than the ocean waves.

rooms.name: Standing on a Sandbar
rooms.desc:
Waves sweep forward from the surrounding ocean to the north but the
sandbar you are on prevents any further travel to the south where you can
see much calmer waters. You can travel to the east or west along the sandbar,
south into the sheltered bay or north into the ocean waves.

rooms.name: Standing on a Sandbar
rooms.desc:
You stand at the eastern end of a small sandbar which stretches away to
the west. You can walk onto an old looking jetty to the north but it doesn't
look overly safe given its current condition of neglect.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
You emerge from the thickness to the south and the view before you leaves
you breathless. Standing at the top of an 80-foot cliff, the world around
you is amazing to say the least. Ocean waves crash against the cliff face
to the west while the waters of the island lagoon lap calmly to the east.
Behind you, the island you find yourself on is covered in all forms of
plant-life which make travel look difficult.
   Towards the southwestern corner of the island you can see a fairly large
wooden structure but you have no idea on how you're going to get there.

rooms.name: A Shallow Lagoon
rooms.desc:
The sheltered waters of this lagoon are due in part to the sandbar to the
north and an almost vertical cliff to the west. You can wade your way to the
east or south into the lagoon if you wish.

rooms.name: A Shallow Lagoon
rooms.desc:
The waters of this place are quite shallow and you walk easily on the
sandy floor. The sandbar to the north prevents the ocean waves from having
any effect while large cliffs to the west and east provide additional
shelter.

rooms.name: A Shallow Lagoon
rooms.desc:
You are now waist deep in the calm waters of this lagoon. It is quite
temperate and you could certainly swim around in it to relieve the pressures
of your travels. A sandbar to the north provides adequate protection from
the ocean while cliffs further to the west and east shelter the lagoon from
the harsh ocean winds.

rooms.name: A Shallow Lagoon
rooms.desc:
You wade through the shallow waters of the lagoon and now have the choice
of travelling to the west or south. If you wish to dry off, a small sandbar
to the north offers some respite while a cliff face to the east stops you
travelling in that direction.

rooms.name: A Jungle
rooms.desc:
The view before you is absolutely breathtaking. Standing at the top of an
80 foot cliff, the world around you is amazing to say the least. Ocean waves
crash against the cliff face to the east while waters of the island lagoon
lap calmly to the west. Behind you, the island you find yourself on is
covered in all forms of plant-life and you imagine travel will be difficult
in those areas.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
The ground slopes increasingly upwards towards the north and you now find
yourself totally submerged in the jungle. You have the option of continuing
to the north or to the south.

rooms.name: A Shallow Lagoon
rooms.desc:
Steep cliffs to the east and south block your path and they are simply
not suitable for climbing. The lagoon continues to the east and also to the
north where you see a small sandbar.

rooms.name: A Shallow Lagoon
rooms.desc:
The center of the lagoon offers a good view of the surrounding landscape;
to the north lies a small sandbar which blocks the entrance from ocean waves,
to the south the lagoon narrows as cliff faces converge at what looks like
a beach while to the east and west the lagoon continues.

rooms.name: A Shallow Lagoon
rooms.desc:
The center of the lagoon offers a good view of the surrounding landscape;
to the north lies a small sandbar which blocks the entrance from ocean waves,
to the south the lagoon narrows as cliff faces converge at what looks like
a beach while to the east and west the lagoon continues.

rooms.name: A Shallow Lagoon
rooms.desc:
Steep cliffs to the east and south block your path and they are simply
not suitable for climbing. The lagoon continues to the west and also to the
north where you see a small sandbar.

rooms.name: A Jungle
rooms.desc:
The end of the path is not far from here, a few short steps further to
the north. You are quite high above the surrounding waters now, the lagoon
to the west and the ocean to the east - a fall from this height would surely
be fatal.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
It is difficult to imagine anyone having walked through this place before
judging by the size of the grass, the overgrown bushes and the closely packed
trees. You have to fight your way forward and the effort is tiring to say
the least.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
You emerge from the thick vegetation and almost plunge head first down
a rocky cliff face. You stand overlooking the western edge of the lagoon
which lies a fair distance below you. You have no option but to return to
the jungle.

rooms.name: A Shallow Lagoon
rooms.desc:
A school of little fish passes close by and darts away at the last second
to avoid hitting you. A small section of sand to the south offers a dry
place to stand while the waters of this lagoon continue to the north and east.

rooms.name: A Shallow Lagoon
rooms.desc:
You find it slightly difficult to walk in the lagoon given the sandy
bottom and the waist deep water you are in. You can make your way slowly
to the west or north to remain in the lagoon or to the south where a small
beach offers a place to dry off.

rooms.name: A Jungle
rooms.desc:
There is a small worn path here and it looks like someone or something
has made an effort to keep the place clear of vegetation. You find yourself
walking along a narrow ledge on top of a cliff, to the west lies the shallow
waters of the lagoon while to the east the path continues.

rooms.name: A Jungle
rooms.desc:
You almost trip over a hidden rock and fall over the cliff edge to the
east. Regaining your composure, you look out at the vast ocean which lies
to the east and south. The path continues to the west and further upwards to
the north.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
The lushness of this area stops suddenly as you stand on the edge of a
large cliff. The ocean lies before you to the west and waves crash against
the cliff face with an almighty force. A narrow walkway exists to the south
which appears to follow the ridgeline above the cliff and is free from the
undergrowth which dominates the rest of the island.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
You stumble into a small clearing in the thick vegetation, a fruit tree of
some sort grows in the middle. Some of the fruit lies on the ground and in no
way looks edible, but there are still some pieces in the tree.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
The ground rolls gently as you make your way through the dense growth.
It is quite thick in areas and at times you lose your direction and
orientation, but you manage to push forward. There is a small sandy area to
the east.

rooms.name: A Sandy Beach
rooms.desc:
You make your way along a section of beach which also extends to the east.
Water laps at your feet, a silent invitation to enter the lagoon to the
north. Almost immediately to the west and south of here, a dense jungle blocks
any view of what lies beyond.

rooms.name: A Sandy Beach
rooms.desc:
You make your way along a section of beach which also extends to the west.
Water laps at your feet, a silent invitation to enter the lagoon to the
north. A dirt path leads away to the south between overgrown patches of grass
and plant-life.

rooms.name: A Jungle
rooms.desc:
You take a moment to survey the surrounds and are glad you are where you
are. This area is actually quite tame while further to the south and over to
the west, dense growth makes travel look difficult. A sandy beach can be
reached to the west while the terrain here slopes gently upward towards the
north.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
A strong ocean breeze hits you in the face as you skirt the edge of this
ridgeline, an almost vertical cliff face drops to the sea below. The island
sounds alive with bird life but you can hear only their song, they are
nowhere to be seen.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
It doesn't matter where you look, all you can see is an overgrown
collection of trees, bushes and other plant-life. The sound of the ocean is
strong here, perhaps it is not that far away...

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
You continue to trek up and down rolling hills, fighting your way through
the thick vegetation that presents itself. Every direction looks exactly the
same so you have the choice to travel any way you wish.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
Each step you take brings you deeper and deeper into the jungle that
grows all over the island. There is a more open area to the north but apart
from that, you have no guide as to which way to travel.

rooms.name: A Narrow Dirt Path
rooms.desc:
Head high grass quickly closes in around you as you make your way down
the dirt path. It's certainly not impenetrable but perhaps if you were to
follow the path you would have a better chance of getting out of this
mess.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
You once again disappear into the undergrowth and have trouble finding a
way out! You quickly lose your bearings and must rely on instinct if you
wish to leave this place.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
You find yourself skirting the top of a ridgeline, a healthy drop to the
ocean lies to the north and east. You can travel deeper into the dense
vegetation if you wish but finding your way through it may prove to be
difficult.

rooms.name: A Jungle Clearing
rooms.desc:
You stand on a solitary finger of land that juts northward into the
ocean. To the south you can see a clearing in the jungle before the trees
and undergrowth simply closes in and prevents you from seeing further. There
is a single tree in the middle of the clearing that appears to have some
arcane markings on it but you are unsure why.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
You find yourself skirting the top of a ridgeline, a healthy drop to the
ocean lies to the north and west. You can travel deeper into the dense
vegetation if you wish but finding your way through it may prove to be
difficult.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
Dense undergrowth surrounds you giving no clue as to which way you can
travel to get out of here. Every direction looks exactly the same to you
and a sinking feeling comes over you, almost a despair at having to even
be here.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
Dense undergrowth surrounds you giving no clue as to which way you can
travel to get out of here. Every direction looks exactly the same to you
and a sinking feeling comes over you, almost a despair at having to even
be here.
   On a nearby tree, a crudely made spear has been impaled perhaps as a
warning to keep away.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
Dense undergrowth surrounds you giving no clue as to which way you can
travel to get out of here. Every direction looks exactly the same to you
and a sinking feeling comes over you, almost a despair at having to even
be here.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
Dense undergrowth surrounds you giving no clue as to which way you can
travel to get out of here. Every direction looks exactly the same to you
and a sinking feeling comes over you, almost a despair at having to even
be here.

rooms.name: A Narrow Dirt Path
rooms.desc:
This path looks well used and you wonder by whom. High grass lines the
sides making travel off the path extremely difficult but not impossible.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
Dense undergrowth surrounds you giving no clue as to which way you can
travel to get out of here. Every direction looks exactly the same to you
and a sinking feeling comes over you, almost a despair at having to even
be here.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
Dense undergrowth surrounds you giving no clue as to which way you can
travel to get out of here. Every direction looks exactly the same to you
and a sinking feeling comes over you, almost a despair at having to even
be here.

rooms.name: A Jungle Clearing
rooms.desc:
You begin to think you are not alone on this island after walking around
in this jungle clearing. Someone has gone to great effort to ensure the
vegetation does not intrude into this place, perhaps to keep the several
rough-cut tombstones here clearly visible.
   There is quite a steep drop to the north where the ocean waves crash
forcefully into the cliff above which you now stand.

rooms.name: A Jungle Clearing
rooms.desc:
The clearing extends as far as possible to the edge of the cliff which
you now overlook. Gazing to the east, the wide expanse of the ocean opens
before you and you realise the journey down would be both long and painful.

rooms.name: Along a Ridgeline
rooms.desc:
You have reached the corner of a large wooden structure although you have
no idea as to what lies inside as it is surrounded by an equally large wooden
wall. You can travel along the western edge of the structure and this
ridgeline to the south or enter the dense overgrowth to the east.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
You once again disappear into the undergrowth and have trouble finding a
way out! You quickly lose your bearings and must rely on instinct if you
wish to leave this place. The only guide you have is a wooden wall to the
south which prevents you from moving in that direction.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
You once again disappear into the undergrowth and have trouble finding a
way out! You quickly lose your bearings and must rely on instinct if you
wish to leave this place. The only guide you have is a wooden wall to the
south which prevents you from moving in that direction.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
You once again disappear into the undergrowth and have trouble finding a
way out! You quickly lose your bearings and must rely on instinct if you
wish to leave this place. The only guide you have is a wooden wall to the
south which prevents you from moving in that direction.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
You once again disappear into the undergrowth and have trouble finding a
way out! You quickly lose your bearings and must rely on instinct if you
wish to leave this place. The only guide you have is a wooden wall to the
south which prevents you from moving in that direction.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
You once again disappear into the undergrowth and have trouble finding a
way out! You quickly lose your bearings and must rely on instinct if you
wish to leave this place. The only guide you have is a wooden wall to the
south which prevents you from moving in that direction.

rooms.name: A Narrow Dirt Path
rooms.desc:
The dirt path continues to the north and south. The occassional bird call
or rustling in the tall grass grabs your attention but you can't see
anything unless it passes right in front of you.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
Dense undergrowth surrounds you giving no clue as to which way you can
travel to get out of here. Every direction looks exactly the same to you
and a sinking feeling comes over you, almost a despair at having to even
be here.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
Dense undergrowth surrounds you giving no clue as to which way you can
travel to get out of here. Every direction looks exactly the same to you
and a sinking feeling comes over you, almost a despair at having to even
be here.
   There is a rustling noise to the east although with all of the thick
grass and overgrown bushes, you're not sure what it is.

rooms.name: A Jungle Clearing
rooms.desc:
The jungle simply stops to the west and south of here, this small area
having been cleared by someone. A number of tombstones lie scattered around
and you are careful to avoid walking between them...just in case...

rooms.name: A Jungle Clearing
rooms.desc:
The clearing extends as far as possible to the edge of the cliff which
you now overlook. The jungle vegetation grows thicker to the south and you
realize that eventually you will probably have to leave the relative space
of this area and fight your way through it.

rooms.name: Along a Ridgeline
rooms.desc:
You can make your way to the north or south along the ridgeline, the ocean
thunders away below you to the west although to reach it would mean suicide
from this height. The wooden wall parallels the ridgeline and you have no
way of getting into the structure from here.

rooms.name: The Barracks
rooms.desc:
You have a great view of the ocean to the west of the island through one
of the holes in the building's walls. Fresh, salt air blasts your face with
some force which is rather invigorating. Taking another deep breath, you
can continue to the east or south.

rooms.name: The Barracks
rooms.desc:
You continue to wander between what remains of the furniture within
the building. You may travel to the west, south or east.

rooms.name: The Barracks
rooms.desc:
The building appears to have been used as a mass sleeping and accomodation
area. There must be at least a dozen beds, or remnants thereof, within this
place.

rooms.name: The Island Temple
rooms.desc:
Icons have been carved into the wooden altar which is bare apart from a
few bowls and what looks like a candlestick. There is enough room behind it
for the temple priest to preach to the assembled congregation.

rooms.name: The Island Temple
rooms.desc:
Although the temple is often considered a place of sanctuary, you get no
such feelings of peace and safety here. It might just be your imagination
but something in the back of your mind keeps you on guard. Stairs lead from
here to the floor above.

rooms.name: A Narrow Dirt Path
rooms.desc:
The dirt path continues to the north and south of here. There is a large
wooden wall to the west which prevents travel in that direction.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
Dense undergrowth surrounds you giving no clue as to which way you can
travel to get out of here. Every direction looks exactly the same to you
and a sinking feeling comes over you, almost a despair at having to even
be here.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
Dense undergrowth surrounds you giving no clue as to which way you can
travel to get out of here. Every direction looks exactly the same to you
and a sinking feeling comes over you, almost a despair at having to even
be here.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
Dense undergrowth surrounds you giving no clue as to which way you can
travel to get out of here. Every direction looks exactly the same to you
and a sinking feeling comes over you, almost a despair at having to even
be here.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
You find yourself skirting the top of a ridgeline, a healthy drop to the
ocean lies to the south and east. You can travel deeper into the dense
vegetation if you wish, but finding your way through it may prove to be
difficult.

rooms.name: Along a Ridgeline
rooms.desc:
You can make your way to the north or south along the ridgeline, the ocean
thunders away below you to the west although to reach it would mean suicide
from this height. The wooden wall parallels the ridgeline and you have no
way of getting into the structure from here.

rooms.name: The Barracks
rooms.desc:
It dawns on you that given the island is so isolated, that perhaps the
inhabitants of this place were caretakers of some sort. It's obvious that if
they indeed ever arrived here, then they have not been here for some time.
You can continue to the north or east.

rooms.name: The Barracks
rooms.desc:
Although this room has definately been neglected, it has not been
abandoned. There are fresh footprints in the dirt covered floor which 
travel all around the room and leave via the entrance to the east.

rooms.name: The Barracks
rooms.desc:
You are in a run-down building that clearly shows the signs of age.
Numerous holes are in the walls, the floor is covered in all manner of dirt
and small plants have even begun to grow. What look like beds are scattered
around the building.

rooms.name: The Island Temple
rooms.desc:
This structure has been set aside as a temple, a place to shelter from
the elements and find redemption from a greater power than mortal man. Roughly
cut pews have been carved from some of the many tree trunks on the island and
an altar dominates the north-western corner of the room. Further to the
northeast, a set of stairs leads to the floor above.

rooms.name: The Island Temple
rooms.desc:
You take a moment and rest your weary bones on a nearby pew, giving you
time to survey the temple. It certainly isn't as grand as the temples of
Kir Drax'in or Aloazar but serves essentially the same purpose. To the north,
a set of stairs disappears through the ceiling.

rooms.name: A Narrow Dirt Path
rooms.desc:
The dirt path continues to the north and south of here. There is a large
wooden wall to the west which prevents travel in that direction.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
Dense undergrowth surrounds you giving no clue as to which way you can
travel to get out of here. Every direction looks exactly the same to you
and a sinking feeling comes over you, almost a despair at having to even
be here.
   You can just make out a narrow dirt path to the west and south of here.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
Dense undergrowth surrounds you giving no clue as to which way you can
travel to get out of here. Every direction looks exactly the same to you
and a sinking feeling comes over you, almost a despair at having to even
be here.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
You concentrate very closely on making sure you don't fall down the
cliff to the east, the ever-present jungle making that a difficult task.
The trees literally grow right up to the edge and at times you have to hug
them as you make your way along.

rooms.name: Along a Ridgeline
rooms.desc:
You can make your way to the north or south along the ridgeline, the ocean
thunders away below you to the west although to reach it would mean suicide
from this height. The wooden wall parallels the ridgeline and you have no
way of getting into the structure from here.

rooms.name: A Prison Cell
rooms.desc:
The cell is very small and is in no way comfortable - although you would
expect prisoners would not be afforded the luxuries of law abiding citizens.
The eastern wall is made simply of iron bars which show the signs of
corrosion, a likely effect of the sea air. A small window on the western
wall, again with bars to prevent escape, allows you to view the vastness
of the ocean which surrounds the island.

rooms.name: A Narrow Passage
rooms.desc:
The passage ends here with access to one of the three prison cells to
the west. The remains of a chair have been scattered over the floor, the last
occupant suffering the same fate. A crude spear hangs loosely out of the
eastern wall.

rooms.name: A Small Walkway
rooms.desc:
You have reached a T-junction, able to travel to the north, east or
south. A structure to the north looks like it might provide some protection
from the elements but given the huge holes in its walls and roof, you assume
not much.

rooms.name: A Small Walkway
rooms.desc:
You pass two doors; one to the north and the other to the south. The
remains of a paved walkway continue to the west and terminate in an open
courtyard to the east. A number of stocks, some still with remains, line the
sides of the walkway.

rooms.name: A Paved Courtyard
rooms.desc:
You stand at the entrance to a rather grand looking, if not run down,
collection of wooden buildings shielded from the majority of island overgrowth
by large walls. Cracked and mouldy cobblestones cover the ground, adding to
the sense of decay which strikes you. To the east, open gates lead back into
the wilderness while small walkways lead to the west and south.

rooms.name: A Narrow Dirt Path
rooms.desc:
You stand at a junction in a narrow dirt path that winds its way
through the overgrowth to the north and east. Large trees and all manner of
plant-life surround the path which would make travel difficult. There is
a large, open gate to the west which allows entry into a paved courtyard.

rooms.name: A Narrow Dirt Path
rooms.desc:
The path weaves its way in and out of large clumps of vegetation and at
times you think you have actually turned around and are heading the wrong
way. You can continue along the path to the west or east.

rooms.name: A Narrow Dirt Path
rooms.desc:
The path curves suddenly to avoid a large banana tree and you have the
choice of moving along it to the west or south.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
The thick vegetation gives way slightly, enough for you to see a narrow
path to the west and the ocean expanse to the east. You could be mistaken,
but there appears to be some type of wooden structure towards the southeast
part of the island.

rooms.name: Along a Ridgeline
rooms.desc:
You can make your way to the north or south along the ridgeline, the ocean
thunders away below you to the west although to reach it would mean suicide
from this height. The wooden wall parallels the ridgeline and you have no
way of getting into the structure from here.

rooms.name: A Prison Cell
rooms.desc:
The cell is very small and is in no way comfortable - although you would
expect prisoners would not be afforded the luxuries of law abiding citizens.
The eastern wall is made simply of iron bars which show the severe signs of
corrosion. A skeleton has been nailed to the western wall, sharp metal spikes
through its hands and feet.

rooms.name: A Narrow Passage
rooms.desc:
The passage continues to the north and south. The size of this place
certainly would not allow many prisoners to be detained - perhaps the
remoteness of the island is all that was intended for people sent here.

rooms.name: A Small Walkway
rooms.desc:
The cobblestones are slightly uneven as if something in the ground below
was trying to force its way upwards. You can continue to the north or south,
buildings either side of you preventing travel to the east or west. Although,
given their state of decay, it's probably not that difficult to simply crash
through the walls.

rooms.name: A Sentry Post
rooms.desc:
The structure is quite small and lacks any furnishings whatsoever. There
is only the single exit to the north which can be closed off if the weather
becomes too much. This place could only serve one purpose and that would be
as some type of guard post, to monitor traffic into and out of the gates
which are visible through a small window in the eastern wall.
   Of course, now the post is nothing more than a few wooden planks strung
together. Various forms of fungi grow on the walls and floor and the smell
of decay floats in from all directions.

rooms.name: A Small Walkway
rooms.desc:
You pass between the wall and a ramshackle structure to the west. The
semi-paved cobblestone walkway, in a severe state of disrepair, continues to
the north and south. There is a roughly cut opening in the wall of the
structure to the west.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
You hack and slash your way through the undergrowth, small insects buzzing
around you. A wooden wall stretches high above your head to the west and
you can hear what sounds like voices coming from the other side.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
Dense undergrowth surrounds you giving no clue as to which way you can
travel to get out of here. Every direction looks exactly the same to you
and a sinking feeling comes over you, almost a despair at having to even
be here.

rooms.name: A Narrow Dirt Path
rooms.desc:
The path slopes gently upwards to the south. Looking down, you can see
many different sets of footsteps indicating the path is well travelled. You
can hear what sounds like someone chopping a tree down but with the
background noise you can't say which direction it's coming from.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
Dense undergrowth surrounds you giving no clue as to which way you can
travel to get out of here. Every direction looks exactly the same to you
and a sinking feeling comes over you, almost a despair at having to even
be here.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
The lushness of this area stops suddenly as you stand on the edge of a
large cliff. The ocean lies before you to the north and waves crash against
the cliff face with an almighty force. A narrow walkway exists to the west
and the east which follows the ridgeline for a short distance.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
Your trek ends here overlooking a magnificient view of the ocean, its
waves crashing into the base of the cliff upon which you stand. Looking down,
several trees are actually growing horizontally from the cliff face providing
good nesting places for sea birds.
   To the south, you can just make out a narrow dirt path and what looks like
a wooden gate.

rooms.name: Along a Ridgeline
rooms.desc:
You can make your way to the north or south along the ridgeline, the ocean
thunders away below you to the west although to reach it would mean suicide
from this height. The wooden wall parallels the ridgeline and you have no
way of getting into the structure from here.

rooms.name: A Prison Cell
rooms.desc:
The cell is very small and is in no way comfortable - although you would
expect prisoners would not be afforded the luxuries of law abiding citizens.
It has become something of a storeroom, shreds of clothing of crude weapons
have been dumped on the floor. Decomposed bodies, or parts thereof, have
been hung from the bars to dry.

rooms.name: The Prison Entrance
rooms.desc:
You stand at the southern end of a narrow passage which provides access
to three prison cells on the western side of the building. A door to the
east leads into a small walkway. The sounds of vermin scurrying away are
everywhere, as is the dried blood and bones. The bars have long since rusted
from the salt air and any piece of wood has become a haven for all forms of
fungi.

rooms.name: A Small Walkway
rooms.desc:
The rough walkway turns here and proceeds to the north and east. What
remains of a door lies to the west, providing access to a larger building
compared to those around it. The word "freedom" has been carved into the door
with a crude instrument and the smell of death is very strong from within.

rooms.name: A Small Walkway
rooms.desc:
The walkway twists and turns a little before continuing to the west and
east between a structure to the north and the walls to the south. Jungle rot
has set in over the years and the wood literally falls apart at your touch.
Moisture is rich in the air and it's not long before you sweat profusely with
the intense humidity.

rooms.name: A Small Walkway
rooms.desc:
The walkway curves here and you can continue to the north or west. The
sound of the ocean calls to you from the distance and a number of bird calls
add life to this place. Skeletons with shreds of clothing have been strung
up on the southern wall, sharp wooden stakes still evident protruding through
various parts of their once whole bodies.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
You use the wall to the west as a reference point to stop yourself from
getting lost, which silly as it may sound is highly likely. The dense
undergrowth surrounds you to the south, east and north.

rooms.name: A Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
Dense undergrowth surrounds you giving no clue as to which way you can
travel to get out of here. Every direction looks exactly the same to you
and a sinking feeling comes over you, almost a despair at having to even
be here.

rooms.name: A Narrow Dirt Path
rooms.desc:
The path curves here, continuing to the north and east. Bird calls taunt
you from the thick vegetation either side of the path and the option to
investigate is open to you.

rooms.name: A Narrow Dirt Path
rooms.desc:
The sound of the ocean is strong here...you can almost feel the force of
the waves as they strike the base of the island. The dirt path on which you
stand travels east and west and it looks relatively well-used, but by whom you
do not know.

rooms.name: A Narrow Dirt Path
rooms.desc:
The path hugs a wooden wall to the south as it continues to the east and
west. There appears to be some sort of gate further to the east and you can
also make out a number of voices from the other side of the wall.

rooms.name: A Narrow Dirt Path
rooms.desc:
The dirt path ends abruptly at a set of wooden gates to the south. They
are crudely made from a few of the many trees on the island, but certainly
strong enough to keep someone or something out. Just a little further to the
east lies the island's edge, a steep cliff preventing anyone except the
insane from continuing in that direction.

rooms.name: Along a Ridgeline
rooms.desc:
You have reached the corner of a large wooden structure although you have
no idea as to what lies inside as it is surrounded by an equally large wooden
wall. You can travel along the western edge of the structure and this
ridgeline to the north or enter a small clearing to the south.

rooms.name: Along a Ridgeline
rooms.desc:
You can make your way to the east or west along the ridgeline. The ocean
thunders away below you to the south, although to reach it would mean suicide
from this height. The wooden wall parallels the ridgeline and you have no
way of getting into the structure from here.

rooms.name: Along a Ridgeline
rooms.desc:
You can make your way to the east or west along the ridgeline. The ocean
thunders away below you to the south, although to reach it would mean suicide
from this height. The wooden wall parallels the ridgeline and you have no
way of getting into the structure from here.

rooms.name: Along a Ridgeline
rooms.desc:
You can make your way to the east or west along the ridgeline. The ocean
thunders away below you to the south, although to reach it would mean suicide
from this height. The wooden wall parallels the ridgeline and you have no
way of getting into the structure from here.

rooms.name: Along a Ridgeline
rooms.desc:
You can make your way to the east or west along the ridgeline. The ocean
thunders away below you to the south, although to reach it would mean suicide
from this height. The wooden wall parallels the ridgeline and you have no
way of getting into the structure from here.

rooms.name: Along a Ridgeline
rooms.desc:
You can make your way to the east or west along the ridgeline. The ocean
thunders away below you to the south, although to reach it would mean suicide
from this height. The wooden wall parallels the ridgeline and you have no
way of getting into the structure from here.

rooms.name: Along a Ridgeline
rooms.desc:
You can make your way to the east or west along the ridgeline, or to the
north along a large wooden wall. This point appears to be the southeastern
corner of a wooden structure within the walls, although you don't know where
the entrance lies as the thick vegetation hides almost everything.

rooms.name: Along a Ridgeline
rooms.desc:
You can make your way to the east or west along the ridgeline. The dense
undergrowth, although not inviting, lies to the north.

rooms.name: Along a Ridgeline
rooms.desc:
You can make your way to the east or west along the ridgeline. The dense
undergrowth, although not inviting, lies to the north.

rooms.name: Along a Ridgeline
rooms.desc:
You can make your way to the west along the ridgeline or fight your way
through a patch of tall grass to the north. Your passage east is stopped by
a large wooden wall while to the south, a hefty drop to the ocean makes
you think twice.

rooms.name: A Ramshackle Hut
rooms.desc:
The hut has been constructed using materials from the forest: trees, long
grass, leaves and bark. You can tell some time has gone into its creation,
but it still looks as if it will fall down with the slightest of breezes.
A number of human skulls hang from the western wall as if it were a trophy
case.

rooms.name: An Enclosed Compound
rooms.desc:
You stand at the entrance of a wide, open area enclosed within wooden
walls. Someone has gone to a great effort to both clear this place of
vegetation and ensure it remains clear. Ramshackle huts sit in the corners
to the west, east and further away to the southwest and southeast. A narrow
dirt path leads away to the north into the dense jungle.

rooms.name: A Ramshackle Hut
rooms.desc:
The hut has been created with great care although looking at it, you
wouldn't have realized that. It's rather ingenious really, the combination
of natural materials used to create a haven from the elements. The other
huts within the compound look very similar and can be approached to the
west, southwest or south from here.

rooms.name: A Clearing Above the Ocean
rooms.desc:
You have an almost perfect 180 degree view to the south and can see that
you are almost at the southern-most point of the island. Tracks lead to the
north and east along a high ridgeline which skirts around a large wooden
structure just near here.

rooms.name: A Clearing Above the Ocean
rooms.desc:
You walk right up to the cliff edge and peer over...it's a fantastic view
but you'd prefer to see it from up here than to watch it as you fall to the
ocean waves below. The clearing continues to the west and a small track lies
just north of here.

rooms.name: An Enclosed Compound
rooms.desc:
You skirt the western wall and have the choice of entering one of the huts
to the north or south. Alternatively, you could walk around the compound
further by moving to the east.

rooms.name: An Enclosed Compound
rooms.desc:
This is the center of the compound, an area that was perhaps used for
storage at one time or another but now is home to some of the island
inhabitants. This place is well travelled given the number of footprints on
the ground and you think you can hear voices coming from the hut to the north
west.

rooms.name: An Enclosed Compound
rooms.desc:
As you walk along the eastern wall, the sound of the ocean is quite
strong. It's as if it lies beyond the wall itself, so perhaps it would be
prudent not to get to close to the edge. You can enter one of the ramshackle
huts to the north or south.

rooms.name: A Ramshackle Hut
rooms.desc:
At a bare minimum, the hut provides some protection from the elements, but
not much else. You could never expect privacy since two of the four walls
don't even exist. A few sleeping mats, made from the long grass that grows
plentifully on the island lie around here.

rooms.name: An Enclosed Compound
rooms.desc:
You are careful not to get too close to the southern wall as the ground
appears to be falling away and you known the ocean lies just beyond. You can
enter one of two huts, either to the west or east or move back into the center
of the compound to the north.

rooms.name: A Ramshackle Hut
rooms.desc:
The ground rumbles every few minutes, possibly due to the ocean waves
which you can hear striking the island. You can see other huts to the west
and north from here.

rooms.name: On the Ocean
rooms.desc:
You are floating above the turbulent surface of the ocean.  As you voyage
across the sea's surface, you note your image below, fading with the eddies.
A bit further to the south east, you notice what looks like a sandbar
breaking the surface of the waves.

rooms.name: On the Ocean
rooms.desc:
Waves crash onto a sandbar just to the south of here. You have to fight
the tow to remain where you are so perhaps it is best if you move on before
you lose your strength.

rooms.name: On the Ocean
rooms.desc:
A large wave crashes down upon you and forces you beneath the surface.
You twist and turn, not sure which way is up or in which direction you are
travelling. You just manage to break the surface and gasp for air before
another wave hits you - you catch a quick glimpse of what appears to be a
sandbar to the south.

rooms.name: On the Ocean
rooms.desc:
You are being tossed around in the ocean waves and have the option of
climbing onto a run-down dock to the east or clawing your way up a small
sandbar to the south.

rooms.name: A Rickety Jetty
rooms.desc:
Perhaps in its day this may have been a suitable area for landing a ship.
Now, the ocean has literally torn the jetty apart and what little remains
does so out of spite! You can carefully move your way to the north or south
along the jetty or plunge into the ocean to the east or west.

rooms.name: On the Ocean
rooms.desc:
The wide water spans across your perception, making you lose all sense
of direction. You marvel at the schools of salmon that streak through the
water as though they were birds coasting in the air. To the west, a rickety
looking jetty breaks the ocean monotony.

rooms.name: On the Ocean
rooms.desc:
You are floating without direction on the surface of the water. As you
float above the surface, waves crash into you, forcing you to pay attention
to the water's motion. A sandbar breaks the surface of the ocean to the
east while a vertical cliff face to the south prevents travel in that
direction.

rooms.name: On the Ocean
rooms.desc:
You are floating without direction on the surface of the water. As you
float above the surface, waves crash into you, forcing you to pay attention
to the water's motion. A sandbar breaks the surface of the ocean to the
west while a vertical cliff face to the south prevents travel in that
direction.

rooms.name: A Rickety Jetty
rooms.desc:
You stand on the end of a barely recognisable wooden jetty. Rotten ropes
still remain tied to the support posts which are about the only thing holding
the jetty together. You can travel along the jetty to the south where you
can see a small sandbar or into the ocean in any other direction.

rooms.name: Climbing the Staircase
rooms.desc:
The stairs ascend a simple wooden bell tower and descend into a small
temple below. The wind strength is obviously increasing since it is now
making an audible noise as it buffets against the tower.

rooms.name: Climbing the Staircase
rooms.desc:
You are almost at the top of the tower, just another flight of stairs to
climb. Unfortunately, you are not as close to the ground floor which offers
relatively more safety than this old wooden structure. You can feel the
tower sway with the wind and are concerned that it may not remain standing
for too much longer.

rooms.name: The Top of the Bell Tower
rooms.desc:
You are offered a remarkable 360 degree view of the island and surrounding
ocean. Rough waves crash into the cliff faces, an extensive reef preventing
anything from coming remotely close to the island. There is, however, a
sandbar on the northern side which would allow a ship to dock if it were
careful enough.
   You're almost blown from your vantage point by the now strong wind which
cuts through your armor and clothes. The bell that hangs here is no more than
a rusted shell, incapable of creating very much noise. Stairs are the only
exit from the top of the tower.

rooms.name: Beneath the Reliquery
rooms.desc:
This is a rather small room but by church standards is adequate for the
storage of religious items. It has been kept hidden and for good reason, the
theft of these holy relics would prove to be a great loss to the temple priest.
